source.snippet: Independent podcasters spend 2-3 hours per episode writing show notes, chapter timestamps, and promotional social posts by hand.

problem_statement: Independent podcasters spend 2-3 hours per episode writing show notes, chapter timestamps, and promotional social posts by hand.
target_segment: Monetizing indie podcasters and small podcast networks
notes: Buyer pays today: tools like Capsho and Swell AI charge $30-80/mo for exactly this. Fully automatable: upload transcript/audio, Claude produces notes + timestamps + 5 social posts, emailed back. No human in the loop. Recurring per-episode demand.
